meta.name: multi-reviewer-patterns
meta.description: Coordinate parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions with finding deduplication, severity calibration, and consolidated reporting. Use this skill when organizing multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协调多路并行代码审查，去重并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常组织多人代码审查并需统一汇总反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel code reviews, deduplicate findings, and consolidate results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often organize code review with multiple reviewers and need consolidated feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你组织多维度代码评审:分配安全、性能、架构等评审维度,按文件行号合并重复的发现,统一校准严重级别,并产出一份按 Critical/High/Medium/Low 分组的合并评审报告。
howto.when: 当你组织多维度代码评审、需要校准某条发现的严重级别,或要合并多个评审者的结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 PR 组织一次多维度代码评审
say.note: 会先建议评审维度,再汇总成一份报告

say.text: 把两位评审者报的同一处问题合并去重
say.note: 按 file:line 合并,严重级别取较高者

say.text: 这次 API 改动该跑哪些评审维度?
say.note: 会给出现成的维度组合建议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can organize multi-dimensional code reviews: assign dimensions like security, performance, and architecture, merge duplicate findings by file:line, calibrate severity consistently, and produce one consolidated report grouped into Critical/High/Medium/Low.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you organize a multi-dimensional code review, calibrate the severity of a finding, or consolidate results from several reviewers.

say_en.text: Organize a multi-dimensional code review for this PR
say_en.note: Suggests dimensions, then consolidates a report

say_en.text: Merge the duplicate findings from both reviewers
say_en.note: Merges by file:line, keeping the higher severity

say_en.text: Which review dimensions should this API change use?
